run-command.instruction: Patch src/cli/types.ts and src/cli/runCommand.ts, every other line as it is. types.ts: `import type { SuiteResult } from "./suiteNet.js";` and RunDocument gains the optional last key `suite?: SuiteResult`. runCommand.ts: `import { suiteNet } from "./suiteNet.js";`; after archiveRun and before the document: `const suite = result.report.fault === undefined ? await suiteNet(root, deck.cards, deps.env) : null;` (deck is the loaded deck whose cards the run took); the document is {runId, branch, base, report, archive} and, when suite is not null, suite as its last key; code = 3 when report.fault is set, else runExitCode(result.report, archive), then 1 when that is 0 and suite !== null && !suite.ok.

suite-net-judge.instruction: Write ONLY tests/cli/suiteNet.examples.test.ts, one test per Suite Net example, named "Suite Net example <n>: <what>". Each test builds its own tmpRoot (tests/helpers.ts) and removes it in finally. Skeleton: `const f = fixtureJson("cli/suiteNet.json") as {files: Record<string, string>; cards: {customId: string; targets: string[]; acceptance: string}[]; vitest: Record<string, string>};` `const t = tmpRoot(); for (const [rel, text] of Object.entries(f.files)) t.write(rel, text); fs.chmodSync(t.write("node_modules/.bin/vitest", f.vitest.red), 0o755);` `const cards = f.cards.map((c) => ({ ...c, intent: "generate", contextSlice: [], instruction: "x", model: null, maxTokens: null, reasoning: null, variants: 1, dependsOn: [] }) as Card);` `const got = await suiteNet(t.root, cards, { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? "" });`. The fake vitest appends its arguments to vitest.args at the tmp root: t.read("vitest.args"), t.exists("vitest.args"). Imports: `import fs from "node:fs"`, test and expect from vitest, suiteNet from ../../src/cli/suiteNet.js, fixtureJson and tmpRoot from ../helpers.js, type Card from ../../src/cards/types.js. Compare whole results with toStrictEqual; null with toBe(null).

suite-net.instruction: Write src/cli/suiteNet.ts, a new file. Imports, nothing else: `import fs from "node:fs"`, `import { posix } from "node:path"`, `import { runAcceptance, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS } from "../acceptance/run.js"`, `import { RELATED_LINE } from "../builder/compose.js"`, `import type { Card } from "../cards/types.js"`. Export exactly: `RELATED_MARK` ("echo '== full'; " + RELATED_LINE.slice(0, RELATED_LINE.indexOf("{test}"))), `SUITE_LINE`, `SUITE_SCRIPT`, `interface SuiteResult { command: string; ok: boolean; failing: string[]; cards: string[]; log: string }` and `async function suiteNet(root: string, cards: readonly Card[], env: Record<string, string>, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<SuiteResult | null>`. runAcceptance(command, root, {env, timeoutMs}) resolves {exit: number | null, log: string, timedOut: boolean}; exit 0 is green, anything else (null included) red. A card's acceptance is string | null. A file read: fs.statSync(abs).isFile() in try/catch (absent → not a file), then fs.readFileSync(abs, "utf8"); no process, no env, no clock, no child_process.
